Find in the Formorgar Mines, near Svargrond, the mine plan (a {item:Map (Brown)|map} on a pile of bones) and the elevator instructions (a {item:Paper|paper} in a box, at the bottom of the mines). With both you unlock the {wiki:Hoist|Hoist}, the elevator at the mine entrance, which takes you quickly between the floors.
With this quest you gain access to the Hoist (elevator) at the entrance of the Formorgar Mines. With it you can get to other floors much more easily.
No minimum level, but the recommended level is **120**.
Access to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}: have done {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} up to the mission *Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission*.
Potions and good protection: on the lower floors there are {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} and {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}
Being able to use the {wiki:Hoist|Hoist} of the Formorgar Mines
With the mine plan (the {item:Map (Brown)|map}) and the instructions (the {item:Paper|paper}): each unlocks different trips between the floors.
Without the map you can't go from floor 1 to floor 2.
You do not need to carry the map and the paper around to use the Hoist: you just have to open the containers where they are.
If you already have access to the {item:Ice Portal} in the {wiki:Halls of Hope|Halls of Hope}, you can use it to save time.
On the deepest floor, right at the bottom of the ramp, you are ambushed by 2–3 {creature:Enlightened of the Cult} and 1–2 {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}. Go prepared.
Follow {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest} (mission Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission) until you reach the Formorgar Mines.

If you are not in **Svargrond** yet, take a boat there (for example in Carlin or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city. Leave Svargrond to the **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the route through the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier|Formorgar Glacier} to the entrance of the mines. At the end of the path go down the stairs: you are on the first floor of the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}.
Numbered route from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines
First floor of the mines: the yellow circle is the exit ramp (the Hoist is nearby); the pink circles are the stairs to floor 2
If you have access to the {item:Ice Portal} of the {wiki:Halls of Hope|Halls of Hope} (north of Thais, via the Forgotten Knowledge Quest), it takes you directly into the mines.

From the entrance, go **south** and stop at the **third** exit to the **west**. Go west to the **second** exit to the **south**. Go south until you hit the wall. Go **east** to the **second** exit to the south. Go south and turn east as soon as you can. Keep going **east** until you reach a {wiki:Ramp|ramp} going down.
Star: way down to the floor below

On this floor there are {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}, {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult}, {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}, a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and a {creature:Hunter}.

Shortcut: if you have met the requirements, use the {item:Ice Portal} of the {wiki:Halls of Hope|Halls of Hope}. The {wiki:Lion Trophy Quest|Lion Trophy Quest} is northeast of the entry point coming from the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier|Formorgar Glacier}, and the Hoist is east of it.

On the second floor, walk just a little **west** from the ramp until you find a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|Pile of Bones} on the **north** side of the mine. Open it to receive the {item:Floor Plan of the Formorgar Mines (Book)|Floor Plan of the Formorgar Mines} (a {item:Map (Brown)|map}).
Route on the second floor to the pile of bones
From the ramp to the skeleton
The Pile of Bones with the map
On this floor there are {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes} and {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult}, as well as {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}.
Floor Plan of the Formorgar Mines — you can now use the Hoist from floor 2 to floor 3
Back to the first floor and down at the star
From the pile of bones go back **east** and climb the ramp you came by. On the first floor go to the **star** mark and go down here.
Going to the cross and down
You are now on the second map's floor. Go back to the star mark and keep going a little further **east** until you reach the **cross** mark. Go down here.

Follow this route from the cross:
1. Right at the bottom of the ramp you are ambushed by 2–3 {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened} and 1–2 {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.
2. Go **west** to the **second** exit to the **south** (1–2 {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} and, at the bend to the south, a {creature:Destroyer} with a Nightmare).
3. Go **south** to a dead end (1–2 Nightmares, a few Crystal Spiders, a {creature:Lost Soul} next to the Hoist and many Enlightened).
4. A little **north** of the dead end, go **west** and turn **south** as soon as you can (Crystal Spiders and a Nightmare).
5. Keep going **south** (many Enlightened, 1–2 Crystal Spiders, 1–2 Nightmares).
6. Keep going **east** and then **south** to a dead end (only Enlightened and maybe a Nightmare at the end).
7. A little **north** of that dead end, turn **west** and follow it to the ramp going up (Enlightened, {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts}, Crystal Spiders and 1–2 Nightmares). Go up here.

This is the most dangerous floor: {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened}, {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts}, {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, a {creature:Lost Soul}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}, {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} and possibly other creatures brought by players.
The exclamation mark on the map is the Hoist, but for now you can only use it to **go up**.

This floor is calmer. From the ramp go **west** to the **second** exit to the **north**. Go north and turn **west** as soon as possible. Keep going west until you can turn **north**. Go north until you find a ramp and go down here.
Blue flag: arrival from the ramp

There are {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened}, {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts}, {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes}, {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}. At the end of the cave you find several Crystal Spiders and Ice Golems with a single {creature:Destroyer}.
Opening the box on the last floor

On the last floor go **north** from the ramp to a dead end. There is a {item:Box}: open it to receive the {item:Instructions to the Formorgar Mines Hoist (Book)|Instructions to the Formorgar Mines Hoist} (a {item:Paper|paper}).
Blue flag: arrival from the ramp
The box with the Hoist instructions
Here there are a few {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened}, a {creature:Nightmare} and 1–2 {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}.
3. Using the Hoist and leaving the mines
What the Hoist lets you do
Each item you obtain unlocks different Hoist trips:
What you can do with the Hoist
Going from floor 3 to 2, from 2 to 3 and from 2 to 1, and changing the Hoist destination on floor 2
You **cannot** go from floor 1 to floor 2

To leave, go back to the blue flag of the fifth and fourth maps and then to the exclamation mark of the third, where the Hoist is, if you want to return via the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier|Formorgar Glacier}. To get back quickly to the {wiki:Halls of Hope|Halls of Hope}, go to the cross instead and then to the star of the second map. Via the Hoist: with the paper you can go up from floor 2 to 1; on the first floor, the exit ramp of the mines (yellow circle on the first floor map) is near the Hoist. Outside, retrace the Formorgar Glacier route to **Svargrond** (go down with {spell:Levitate} where you went up). To leave the island, take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}/{key:thais}/{key:venore}, {key:yes}). The {item:Ice Portal}, if you have unlocked it, takes you back to the Halls of Hope, north of Thais.
First floor: the yellow circle marks the ramp out of the mines
Also known as the Hoist Quest, Formorgar Mines Elevator or Mines Elevator.
You cannot go from floor 1 to floor 2 by Hoist if you have not obtained the map.
